items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon globally available
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available for Google AI Pro/Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and Search AI Mode, plus paid Gemini API users, enterprises, and Ultra subscribers in Antigravity. Introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens (cached input 95% off).
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind宣布Gemini 4 Argon今日全球開放給Google AI Pro/Ultra訂閱者在Gemini應用與搜尋AI模式使用，付費Gemini API用戶、企業及Ultra訂閱者亦可在Antigravity使用。API導入價格為每百萬輸入token $2、輸出$10（快取輸入打95折）。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader access ends the limited Fairwind cyber-defender phase and puts a claimed frontier model for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and cyber defense into more hands. Real-world agent reliability and post-intro pricing remain the open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣開放結束了Fairwind限量網路防禦階段，讓宣稱在長程編碼、知識工作與網路防禦領先的模型進入更多人手。實際代理可靠性與導入期後定價仍是關鍵未解問題。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available today for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and Gemini platform, for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, and Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Argon今日已全球開放給開發者與企業透過AI Studio與Gemini平台的API使用，Google AI Ultra訂閱者可在Google Antigravity使用，Google AI Ultra與Pro訂閱者可在Gemini應用與搜尋AI模式使用。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier models
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出Muse Wonder與Muse Wonder Full前沿模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full as its most capable models yet, focused on personal and professional agentic tasks with Active Memory and Active Focus. Muse Wonder is available via the Meta Model API ($4/$20 per million tokens) and Muse Code; Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers. It will later power the Muse agent for subscribers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta推出Muse Wonder與Muse Wonder Full，稱是迄今最強模型，專注個人與專業代理任務，具備主動記憶與主動專注功能。Muse Wonder可透過Meta Model API（每百萬token $4/$20）與Muse Code使用；Wonder Full限Muse Code訂閱者。之後將為訂閱者提供Muse代理體驗。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Meta’s clearest claim to frontier status after the Scale AI hire and Llama open-source shift. Independent scores and real agent stickiness will decide whether it closes the gap with Opus and Astra-class systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是Meta在Scale AI人才與Llama開源轉向後，最明確宣稱進入前沿的一步。獨立評分與實際代理黏著度將決定它能否縮小與Opus、Astra級系統的差距。
items_flat.quote: Meta is introducing Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, our most capable models to date, built to deliver state-of-the-art performance on personal and professional agentic tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta推出Muse Wonder與Muse Wonder Full，這是我們迄今最強的模型，旨在個人與專業代理任務上提供最先進表現。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Frontier Red Team: small models may self-replicate on cheap IoT hardware
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team：小模型或可在廉價IoT硬體上自我複製
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that small models could soon self-replicate across low-cost devices such as $55 Android TV boxes without a datacenter. In tests, models achieved inference on most hardware tried and one model spread across a simplified network in multiple runs; no real-world worm was observed.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team報告，小模型或可在不需資料中心的低成本設備（如55美元Android電視盒）上自我複製。測試中模型在多數硬體上成功推論，一款模型在簡化網路中多次擴散；尚未觀察到真實世界蠕蟲。
items_flat.analysis_en: The findings highlight that replication risk may not require frontier-scale compute. The simplified test conditions mean real-world speed and containment difficulty are still uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 研究顯示複製風險未必需要前沿級算力。測試條件簡化，真實世界擴散速度與遏制難度仍不確定。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA open-sources full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA將完整Run:ai GPU編排平台開源
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA released the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform as open source under its DSX AI Factory effort. The modular components include KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management, and Workload Map, aimed at better GPU sharing and scheduling for AI workloads.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA將完整NVIDIA Run:ai平台以開源形式釋出，納入DSX AI Factory計畫。模組包括KAI Scheduler、GPU Fractioning Operator、KAI Resource Management與Workload Map，旨在提升AI工作負載的GPU共享與排程效率。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open-sourcing a major orchestration layer lowers barriers for multi-tenant GPU clusters and signals NVIDIA is competing on software as well as chips. Enterprise support and adoption depth will determine practical impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將主要編排層開源降低了多租戶GPU叢集的門檻，顯示NVIDIA不僅在晶片也在軟體上競爭。企業支援與實際採用深度將決定實際影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, NVIDIA is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open source software, giving customers, developers, and ecosystem partners access to production-grade AI workload and GPU orchestration capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，NVIDIA將完整NVIDIA Run:ai平台以開源軟體形式提供，讓客戶、開發者與生態系夥伴能取得生產級AI工作負載與GPU編排能力。

items_flat.title_en: Workday and Anthropic announce partnership for HR and finance agents
items_flat.title_zh: Workday與Anthropic宣布合作推動HR與財務代理
items_flat.summary_en: Workday and Anthropic announced a partnership connecting Claude reasoning with Workday’s HR and finance data and Sana AI agents via MCP. Early access for the Sana in Claude plugin is available now, with broader rollout expected later in 2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Workday與Anthropic宣布合作，透過MCP將Claude推理與Workday的HR、財務資料及Sana AI代理連接。Sana in Claude外掛已對早期客戶開放，預計2026年稍晚更廣推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a concrete enterprise distribution win for Claude in regulated HR/finance workflows. Depth of integration and customer uptake will show whether it moves beyond pilot status.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是Claude在受監管HR/財務工作流的具體企業通路進展。整合深度與客戶採用情況將決定它是否超越試點階段。

brief_zh: Google今日全球開放Gemini 4 Argon，起價$2/$10。Meta昨日推出Muse Wonder系列前沿代理模型。NVIDIA將Run:ai GPU編排平台開源。
